objective: Can a person interpret operating state and intended action?
setup: Document exact model, firmware, settings, operator experience and participant roles.
Use an appropriate supervised environment and manufacturer-supported operations.
Approach, pause and resume a task within the documented operating envelope.
instructions: Record cues before each state transition and ask observers what they expect next.
Define success and failure criteria before observation; record every attempt and any deviation.
measurementApproach: Code observed behaviors against the stated question. Report participant accounts separately from evaluator inference. Quantitative measures require recorded trials, units and a documented analysis plan.
evidenceRequirements: Source URL or durable record, access date, provenance, configuration and environment.
Continuous footage or documented firsthand observations with event locators; identify edits and missing intervals.
Independent evidence and human review before scoring. Manufacturer claims remain attributed claims.
minimumEvidence: A state-transition sequence with context and participant interpretation. Timing claims need timestamped records.
environmentalConsiderations: Document lighting, noise, space, surface, connectivity, crowding, language and accessibility needs. Compare models only under compatible conditions.
repetitionGuidance: Plan repeated trials before testing behavioral reliability. Record all attempts and interventions. Justify sample size for the research question; one success is not consistency.
successCriterion: The stated interaction objective is achieved in the defined context, supported by recorded behavior and participant interpretation where applicable.
failureCriterion: The objective is not achieved, human interpretation conflicts with intended behavior, or intervention/abort is required. Record what happened without treating missing evidence as failure.
scoringCriteria: Preserved web endpoint: 1 — absent or unclear.
Preserved web endpoint: 5 — exemplary, no instruction needed.

Proposed intermediate anchors: 2 — substantial gaps in documented cases; 3 — objective met with identifiable gaps; 4 — objective met across documented cases with minor gaps. Editorial review required; not active scoring rules.
limitations: Internal draft, not a validated scientific standard or NIST/ASTM test.
No universal recognition threshold, reliability target or sample size is established.
Results are specific to the configuration, population and setting observed.

review.notes: Requires editorial approval, pilot studies and reconciliation of the PDF/web scoring scales.
